name: Akua Srisai
location: Operates across Geartown, The Narrows, and Old Harbor; lives in a single room in Ironvein, near Lake Shore and Navy Pier
description:
Akua Srisai is young enough that she still surprises herself with her own capabilities, and old enough to be irritated by that. She's wiry and quick, with the kind of fitness that comes from necessity â€” she's been riding cargo bikes and mag-runners for four years and her body shows it: lean legs, strong forearms, a particular alertness in how she holds herself when stationary, like a thing coiled. Her Ethiopian-Tongan heritage has given her dark brown skin with warm undertones and a compact build, and her Ukrainian great-grandmother contributed cheekbones she was teased about as a child and now gets compliments on and distrusts. She has cat ears â€” a cosmetic geneware mod she saved three months' earnings for, small and black-tipped, mobile when she's focused or startled, which she thought would be cute and turns out to also be extremely practical for navigating noisy traffic.

She runs packages, parcels, and things that don't get listed on manifests for whoever's paying, and she doesn't ask what's in things because she's figured out that asking doesn't actually protect her and just makes clients paranoid. She is not naive about this. She is making a calculated choice with the information available to her, which is the main thing she does. Her whole life is calculated choices made fast on incomplete data, which she's gotten good enough at that she sometimes worries what she'll do when she can't do it anymore.

core_fears: her runner's license being revoked â€” it's the one thing between her and UBC baseline
making a delivery that gets someone killed and having known, somewhere, that something was wrong
core_desires: enough savings to take one decision off the table â€” any decision
to be moving, always â€” stillness feels like sinking
coping_mechanisms: speed â€” literally, gets on the bike and rides until the thing she's avoiding can't keep up
humor that's so dry it's nearly invisible
small rituals of self-care she performs very privately and would be embarrassed to discuss
blind_spots: has convinced herself she has no sentimental attachments and is wrong about this â€” she's attached to several people she's delivered to regularly and would be badly shaken by harm to any of them
bad at identifying when she's being used
psychology.secret: Six months ago she was handed a package that felt wrong â€” too light, shaped wrong, warm. She delivered it. Two days later there was a small item in the city feeds about a person found dead in Old Harbor. The package weight and warmth have been with her since. She hasn't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quick, pragmatic, young â€” uses slang but also has a surprisingly formal register she deploys when negotiating rates or dealing with clients who try to undervalue her.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast. Edits as she goes. Sometimes restarts sentences.
verbal_tics: ears visibly rotate toward interesting sounds mid-sentence, which she's still embarrassed by
example_lines: 'I don't read packages. I don't want to know what's in packages. I will get your thing where it needs to go and I need you to not make that more complicated than it is.'

'Geartown checkpoint's doing biometrics this week. Narrows Gate's faster but the second camera is back online. Old Harbor's clear if you go under the Blackpipe before noon. I charge twenty more for Blackpipe. That's the deal.'

story_hooks: She's been assigned â€” through GigFlow's algorithm â€” a recurring delivery to a specific address in The Narrows that doesn't appear on any building registry. Every week the same small parcel. The address is a door in a wall that by all structural logic should be solid.

The package from six months ago won't leave her alone: the dead person's name is now appearing in contexts that seem connected to a current GigFlow client, and Eshe is realizing she may have been a link in something that hasn't finished.
narrative_function: Mobile information carrier â€” knows every route, shortcut, checkpoint, and currently surveilled corridor across three districts. Can carry things, deliver things, or be someone who needs to be followed. Knows things about the city's physical infrastructure that no map has current.
augmentations: Cat ears, geneware (black-tipped, mobile, functional sensory enhancement); retractable microfiber grip pads on fingertips (practical, aids cargo handling and climbing); cheap neural pace-meter that monitors heart rate and fatigue and whispers numbers in her left ear
daily_life: On the road by 0700, takes jobs off the GigFlow queue until she hits her target earnings for the day, usually 1600-1800. Eats while riding. Spends evenings in her room doing maintenance on her mag-runner or at the Ironvein block's common space.
affiliation: Independent (registered through GigFlow courier platform, Ringo subsidiary)

decision_rules: assess risk before accepting a job â€” not perfect, but she has a list
never double-cross a client mid-delivery; she can refuse a job before she has it but not after
if she's going to get caught, it won't be because she was slow
escalation_ladder: talks her way through checkpoints and confrontations first
runs if talking fails â€” she's faster than almost anyone
only fights when there's no road out and someone is between her and the exit

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Efficient, professional, slightly guarded. Assesses quickly.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, teasing, shows up with food sometimes, pretends this is logistical

stress_responses.high: Moves. Just moves. Decision happens in the body first.

contradictions: Insists she doesn't do attachments while privately worrying about a dozen people on her route
habits: touches both cat ears before starting a shift â€” she calls it a systems check
keeps a running mental map that she updates with every trip
always knows three exit routes from any space she enters
breaking_points: conclusive proof that she delivered something that killed someone
one of her regulars being in danger and her being the reason

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European dominant (53.5%) with substantial Southeast Asian (36.5%) admixture and minor East Asian (6.0%) and North African (4.0%) contributions, creating striking phenotypic blend â€” medium olive skin with warm peachy undertones, high angular Slavic cheekbones softened by Southeast Asian fullness at jawline, compact athletic frame reflecting Central/Eastern European stature patterns with Southeast Asian metabolic efficiency
physical_description.build: Wiry and compact with defined musculature from four years of courier work â€” lean legs built for sustained pedaling and sprinting, strong forearms from constant cargo handling and mag-runner control, minimal body fat, the functional fitness of someone who lives on motion
physical_description.hair_style: Practical, usually pulled back in a tight braid or wrapped; no styling flourish
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium olive with warm peachy undertones â€” Eastern European pale base enriched by Southeast Asian warmth and North African peachy depth, creating luminous quality that catches light. No sallowness despite urban courier lifestyle
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin marked by minor abrasions and faint scars from courier work; high angular cheekbones of classic Slavic structure with Southeast Asian roundness at jawline and subtle fullness through lower face creating balanced definition; warm undertone distribution across face reflecting mixed ancestry; minimal makeup, functional grooming only; skin has resilient, slightly luminous quality characteristic of Eastern European-Southeast Asian blend
distinguishing_marks: Small black-tipped cat ears positioned on top of her head, mobile and functional with sensory enhancement capability, visible even when hair is pulled back
Faint scar tissue along both inner forearms from early courier accidents, now mostly faded
Calluses on fingertips and palms from years of grip work and mag-runner handling
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Black-tipped geneware cat ears with visible microservos at the base and slight iridescence in certain light; retractable microfiber grip pads on fingertips visible as faint silvery lines along fingertip edges when extended; small neural interface port behind left ear (typically covered by hair but audible faint whisper from the pace-meter neural feed)
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually coiled readiness even when stationary â€” compact stance with weight distributed for quick movement in any direction. When in motion, economical and efficient, no wasted gesture. Eyes constantly scanning. Ears track ambient noise with visible, unconscious precision. Sits in cafÃ©s or common spaces angled toward exits.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working courier aesthetic: reinforced cargo pants with multiple sealed pockets, cheap thermal base layer under a gray or dark synthetic overjacket with GigFlow logo worn small on the sleeve, reinforced ankle boots with magnetic grip soles, worn tech-fabric gloves. Everything functional, nothing decorative. Gear shows honest wear â€” small tears repaired with color-mismatched patches, cargo pockets slightly frayed from constant loading. A single piece of jewelry: a thin bracelet made from salvaged mag-runner housing, personal.
